title: Counts and suppression on the Delivery; one Today line per send
description:
Caducus keeps the per-reader record. The email Delivery holds counts only (queued, sent, failed, suppressed, skipped, delivered, bounced, complained), updated from Caducus, and its outcome. Today shows one line per send: list, items, counts, cost. A suppressed or unconfirmed reader is counted and never mailed; a reader on two matching lists of one Delivery gets one message.

**Acceptance criteria**
- The Delivery's counts match Caducus's records.
- A suppressed reader is counted as suppressed and not mailed.
- Today shows each send with its counts.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- delivery-counts.feature: counts match the transport's records; a suppressed address is not mailed; a reader on two lists gets one message; a complaint suppresses the reader for later sends.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Newsletters and subscriptions: weekly, daily and every new item. Slice code N8 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
